purpose: Deep-dive (mapping layer) for Std XII: per-unit subtopics -> concepts -> 4-source mapping. Keyed by unit_no back to maths-xii-spiral-plan.json (unit metadata is joined from there, not duplicated).

legend.relevance: Editorial exam-emphasis of THIS concept (low | med | med-high | high | none).
legend.pyq_count: Number of past-year questions on the TOPIC CLUSTER this concept belongs to (frequency from official past papers). Clusters span several rows, so a count can repeat across rows and must NOT be summed.
legend.flags: ncert_gap = not in the rationalised NCERT-12 (often removed in the 2020 rationalisation) | ncert_aligned = clean 1:1 | cet_anchor / nda_anchor = primary exam focus for this concept | cet_only = CET-tested but NOT in NDA (droppable for an NDA student) | cet_leaning = both test it, CET more heavily
